message.content:
Oversized linen-blend tunic in a soft oatmeal beige (#E3DCD3), flowing silhouette with drop shoulders and a relaxed hemline that brushes the mid-thigh, crafted from breathable natural fiber.
Wide-leg cropped trousers in charcoal grey (#36454F), straight cut with a high waist and ankle-length finish, made of stretchy cotton-knit for ease of movement during practice.
Minimalist leather slip-on flats in deep olive green (#4B5320) with a flat sole and no heel structure, featuring a rounded toe and smooth upper texture.
Delicate layered gold chain necklace in 18k finish and small dainty hoop earrings in rose gold, paired with a lightweight tote bag in textured canvas for carrying essentials.

This ensemble balances the flowy, unrestricted movement needed for morning yoga practice with a polished yet comfortable look for your coffee meet-up with a friend. The neutral oatmeal and charcoal tones create a calm, grounding palette perfect for an autumn morning under natural daylight, while avoiding any restrictive fabrics or uncomfortable footwear. By skipping heels entirely and choosing prints-free shoes as requested, the outfit honors her comfort needs without sacrificing style.
